title: DBS, JPMorgan launch instant tokenized deposit transfers between US and Singapore
description: DBS and Kinexys by JPMorgan have launched cross-bank transfers of tokenized US dollar deposits between Singapore and the United States, with Ant International as the first user and a weekend legacy-account limitation.
why_it_matters: Connecting two banks' permissioned deposit networks gives corporate treasurers a way to move dollar liquidity across jurisdictions outside normal banking hours. The Partior settlement link and its remaining legacy-account maintenance window show both the progress and practical boundaries of interoperable bank-issued digital money.
keyTakeaways: DBS Token Services and Kinexys by JPMorgan now support cross-bank transfers of tokenized US dollar deposits between Singapore and the United States.
Ant International is the first institutional client using the service for treasury and liquidity management across both markets.
The system uses Partior for settlement orchestration; conversion between traditional and Kinexys blockchain accounts retains a three-hour Saturday interruption.
body:
DBS and Kinexys by JPMorgan announced on November 16, 2026, that institutional clients can transfer tokenized US dollar deposits between blockchain-based accounts in Singapore and the United States around the clock. The launched service links DBS Token Services with Kinexys's permissioned Blockchain Deposit Account network, turning an interoperability framework announced in November 2025 into an operational cross-bank connection.

Ant International is the first client to use the arrangement for treasury and liquidity management across entities in both countries. The banks say Partior provides settlement orchestration, while their collaboration also contributes to the Monetary Authority of Singapore's Project BLOOM interoperability work.

The round-the-clock description has an important qualification: transfers within Kinexys's blockchain deposit network run continuously, but moving money between traditional demand deposit accounts and blockchain deposit accounts still faces a three-hour interruption each Saturday, from 3 p.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern Time. The banks say an enhancement is being developed. This is a service for eligible institutions using bank deposits, not a public cryptocurrency transfer network.

newsWatch.originalDiscoveryTitle: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits

facts.claim: DBS and Kinexys launched a solution for transfers between tokenized dollar deposit accounts in Singapore and the United States.
The new connection links DBS Token Services with the permissioned tokenized deposit network operated by Kinexys.
Ant International is the first client using the service for treasury operations across both countries.
The solution uses Partior to orchestrate settlement between the two bank networks.
The banks originally announced their interoperability framework in November 2025 before this operational launch.
Transfers between traditional and blockchain accounts on Kinexys still have a three-hour Saturday maintenance interruption.
